findings.description: The wrapper now reuses one statistics dict across all calls by clearing and writing into the shared wrapped_f.statistics object, so concurrent calls from different threads mutate the same dict.
findings.rationale: Trigger: two threads call the same @retry-decorated function at once. Mechanism: each call's copy._local.statistics points at the same dict that another call's stats.clear() just emptied and is still filling, whereas before each call got its own fresh dict. Impact: attempt counts and statistics seen inside a call's retry hooks or returned via the shared dict can be corrupted or mixed between threads.
